content.value_statement: AI presentation drafts often fail when names, photos, logos, or data are missing. This skill finds required materials first and creates a manifest for PPTX generation.
actual_capabilities: Scans slide requests for names, photos, logos, statistics, references, and branding.
Asks users to confirm slide structure before material collection starts.
Creates a materials folder workflow and matches uploaded files to slide needs.
Checks image aspect ratio, basic quality, content fit, and placeholder decisions.
Writes a manifest.yml summary for downstream PPTX generation tools.
limitations: Does not generate the final PPTX by itself.
Requires user review for AI-written facts and AI-found images.
Cannot verify private data, internal links, or business metrics without user input.
Needs a separate PPTX skill or tool to finish the deck.

use_cases.title: Prepare Team Introduction Decks
use_cases.description: Collect member names, roles, photos, and logos before the deck is generated.

use_cases.title: Plan Investor Pitch Materials
use_cases.description: Identify missing company facts, product screenshots, financial data, and brand assets.

use_cases.title: Check Training Slide Inputs
use_cases.description: Separate general content from user-specific examples, screenshots, and reference files.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Simple Deck
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare materials for a 5-slide tutorial deck about [topic]. Identify missing items and tell me what can be AI-generated.

prompt_templates.title: Collect Team Assets
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a team introduction deck. Ask for missing names, roles, photos, logos, dates, and contact details before generation.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Pitch Manifest
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this pitch outline and create a material checklist. Track product screenshots, metrics, market claims, team details, and branding.

prompt_templates.title: Audit and Hand Off
prompt_templates.prompt: Scan this deck request, collect files, resolve placeholders, write manifest.yml, and hand off to the available PPTX generation tool.

output_examples.input: A user asks for a seven-slide team introduction deck.
output: The scan lists member names, team photos, logo, milestones, and contact details.
Missing items are separated from AI-generated text that needs review.
The user receives clear upload or placeholder choices before generation.

output_examples.input: A user adds photos and a spreadsheet to the materials folder.
output: The files are matched to slide needs with a short reason for each match.
Aspect ratio and quality warnings are shown before final handoff.

output_examples.input: A user does not have an award photo for one slide.
output: The skill offers AI search, AI generation, placeholder, or later upload.
The selected choice is recorded before the PPTX tool receives the manifest.

best_practices: Confirm the slide structure before collecting files.
Place source images, logos, and spreadsheets in the materials folder.
Review AI-generated facts and AI-found images before PPTX generation.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a final deck before required materials are identified.
Do not treat private metrics, names, or photos as AI-fillable facts.
Do not hand off a manifest with unresolved missing or AI-fill items.

faq.question: Does this skill create the PPTX file?
faq.answer: No. It prepares materials and a manifest, then hands work to a PPTX generation tool.

faq.question: Can I use it without Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The repository includes prompt versions for other chat tools and API use.

faq.question: What files should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide photos, logos, screenshots, spreadsheets, reference documents, and any facts that AI should not invent.

faq.question: What happens when a material is missing?
faq.answer: The skill offers upload, AI search, AI generation, or placeholder choices where appropriate.

faq.question: Why does it create manifest.yml?
faq.answer: The manifest records what each slide needs, where files are stored, and which items require review.

faq.question: Can it verify business data?
faq.answer: Only if the user provides reliable source material. AI-generated business facts are marked for review.
